method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the writing-l4-rules skill; Part 19's duties with deadlines are regulative rules (PARTY ... MUST ... WITHIN ... HENCE ... LEST BREACH ... BECAUSE), and the seat questions read the same named periods; no REFUSE (a pending area and an unmade request are answered in the answer's words, asserted); every judgment for the provider, the Minister or a court asked as an input; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

No instrument brought in (none deposited); Ministerial determinations, standards, rules and the compensation rules are inputs.
